flow.title: Overseer handover
flow.summary: Docs-first handover of the cross-repo overseer role: snapshot truth per repo, update the durable docs (ROADMAP snapshot, next-session plan, coordination doc), then regenerate the living handover block as a projection of them.

steps.owned_job: Snapshot truth per repo, confirmed via muse -C (not ambient).
steps.instruction: Run muse -C <abs path> status and log for each repo (Scooling, Knowtation, MuseHub) and capture branch, HEAD sha, and dirty state.
steps.trigger: Run when a chat is getting long, a chat switch is needed, or a session ends with multi-repo state in flight.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if no multi-repo state is in flight and no handover is needed.
boundaries: Always target each repo with muse -C <absolute-path> — a bare muse can report an ambient repo
Read only — do not commit or checkout during the snapshot
steps.output_shape: A per-repo line for each repo with real branch, HEAD sha, and dirty flag, each confirmed via -C.

verification.description: Each repo is confirmed via -C (not ambient) and every repo line carries a real branch and sha.

steps.owned_job: Record the current step, next action, and open gates/blockers.
steps.instruction: Write down the current initiative step, the unambiguous next action, and any open gates or blockers.
steps.trigger: Run after per-repo truth is captured.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if the next action and gates are already recorded and unchanged.
boundaries: State the next action so it needs no chat history to interpret
steps.output_shape: A current-step line, a next-action line, and an open-gates/blockers list.

steps.owned_job: List the boundaries and the cross-repo wiring touched this session.
steps.instruction: Enumerate the boundaries to honor and the cross-repo wiring touched this session.
steps.trigger: Run after the step and gates are recorded.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if no cross-repo wiring was touched and boundaries are already listed.
boundaries: Boundaries are stated explicitly, not assumed
steps.output_shape: An explicit boundaries list and a cross-repo wiring list for the session.

verification.description: Boundaries are explicit and the cross-repo wiring touched is listed.

steps.instruction: Update the ROADMAP snapshot, the next-session plan, and the coordination doc so they match reality before any block is written.
steps.trigger: Run after truth, step/gates, and boundaries are captured.
steps.when_not_to_run: Never skip when handing off — docs-first ordering is mandatory.
boundaries: Update durable docs before regenerating any handover block
Docs are the source of truth, the block is a projection of them
steps.output_shape: Updated ROADMAP snapshot, next-session plan, and coordination doc reflecting reality.

verification.description: The durable docs are updated and match reality before any block is written.

steps.owned_job: Regenerate the handover block into the living file from the now-current docs.
steps.instruction: Overwrite docs/OVERSEER-HANDOVER.md with a block regenerated from the updated durable docs, not from memory.
steps.trigger: Run only after the durable docs are updated.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if the docs have not yet been updated this handover.
boundaries: The block is a projection of the docs — never hand-written ahead of them
steps.output_shape: An overwritten docs/OVERSEER-HANDOVER.md whose block matches the durable docs.

verification.description: The living file is overwritten and its block matches the docs, not memory.

steps.owned_job: Emit the block as the first message of the next chat.
steps.instruction: Paste the regenerated handover block as the first message of the new chat so the overseer role resumes with no prior history.
steps.trigger: Run once the living file holds the current block.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if no new chat is being started.
boundaries: Emit only the projected block — do not add scope beyond the durable docs
steps.output_shape: The handover block, emitted as the first message of the next chat.

verification.description: A new overseer can resume from the emitted block with no prior chat history.
